full_track.tags: K-Pop Indie Pop. Clean electric guitar plays a syncopated, palm-muted rhythmic pattern. A smooth, mid-range male vocal performs melodic lines with occasional breathy delivery. The bass guitar follows the kick drum with a groovy, staccato feel. A steady drum kit maintains a crisp backbeat with tight hi-hat work. Subtle synth pads provide harmonic depth in the background. 105 BPM, Key of G Major, 4/4 time signature.
